strategy_roster.name: Smart Ass Trade
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) histogram direction and SMA(20) slope are a current-timeframe proxy for the required 5m/15m/30m alignment. Williams %R, daily filtering, multi-timeframe state, and point-based protection are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Ultra WPR Cross
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is unavailable, so smoothed RSI(13) with SMA(3)/SMA(53) preserves the documented fast/slow crossing periods. Price-based point stops, short handling, and H4 resampling are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: EMA WMA Contrarian
strategy_roster.notes: WMA is unavailable, so EMA(28)/EMA(8) on candle opens proxy the documented contrarian crossover and opposite exit. Point stops, targets, trailing, risk sizing, and the short branch are not representable here.

strategy_roster.name: XOSignal Re-Open
strategy_roster.notes: An EMA(20) plus/minus 1.5-ATR(13) channel is a state-free proxy for the XO range and arrow signals. XO box resets, pyramiding, tick stops/targets, delayed signal bars, and short re-entry are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: TenPointThree MACD Grid
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) crossover with a negative main line is a current-bar proxy for the documented shifted crossover. Grid layering, money management, per-leg exits, trading-range threshold, and session controls are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Alerting System Threshold
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy is a one-shot bid/ask threshold alert utility with no entries or exits. An impossible negative-price guard preserves that behavior; configurable price levels and notifications are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: BreakOut15
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20)/SMA(50) crossover plus a prior 20-bar high break is a transparent proxy for the moving-average-filtered breakout. Exact parameters, staged trailing protection, and the short branch are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Combo Right Perceptron
strategy_roster.notes: CCI and the perceptron lattice are unavailable; open and close above/below their SMA(10) baselines proxy the positive/negative CCI supervisor signal. Perceptron strides, weights, point protection, and short handling are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Master Exit Plan
strategy_roster.notes: Master Exit Plan is explicitly a supervisor for existing exposure and does not open trades. An impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating an entry; timers, pending trails, and point stops are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Killer Sell 2.0 (C#)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented strategy is short-only, while this roster is long-direction; no long rule can be translated without fabricating one. An impossible negative-price guard records that limitation rather than inverting the sell logic.
